stories.story_title: OpenAI Tests GPT-4 for Biological Threat Risks
stories.why_this_story: OpenAI published an evaluation measuring whether GPT-4 increases the risk of biological threat creation, establishing an early blueprint for catastrophic risk testing.
stories.viral_angle: Can AI actually give non-experts the knowledge to create biological threats? OpenAI put it to the test.
stories.story_sentence: Everyone fears AI could easily enable biological threat creation, but OpenAI's initial evaluation showed at most a mild, inconclusive uplift in accuracy.

stories.caption:
Can AI help non-experts create biological threats? OpenAI put GPT-4 to the test with biology experts and students.

The result? At most a mild uplift in threat creation accuracy—a difference not large enough to be statistically conclusive.

While current models don't provide a massive shortcut over standard search tools, building these evaluation blueprints now is crucial for spotting leaps in future model capability.
